title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_was_ist_deutsch_by_peter_trawny_ja7gn (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_was_ist_deutsch_by_peter_trawny_ja7gn' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised system is strongly advised.
